test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: With which musical instrument can you associate the name of Ali Akbar Khan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan **played the sarod, a stringed, lute like instrument that is part of the musical tradition in Hindustan.
 
• Khan became instrumental in popularizing Indian classical songs in the West, both as a performer and as an instructor.
 
• Khan was accorded India's second highest civilian honor, the **Padma Vibhushan, in 1989**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ali Akbar Khan was awarded the Padma Bhushan **in 1967 **and the Padma Vibhushan in 1989.
 
• **The Sarangi** is a fretless, bowed string tool used in Hindustani classical songs and folk traditions of north India.
 
• **The Rudra Veena** is noted in court docket statistics as early because of the reign of **Zain-ul Abidin. **
